exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Deciding on something".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 名詞にする matches "Deciding on something".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 名詞にする.
exercises.explanation: Expresses choosing or deciding on something from available options.
